description:
Watch AI dramas where YOU decide the story — then step into one yourself.

SagaNova is a cinema of AI-made interactive dramas and short dramas. Binge original series, choose what happens next, and unlock endings no one else has seen. When you're ready — scan your face and star in the next one.

WATCH — AI INTERACTIVE DRAMA
• Original interactive series like "Seven Ways to Be Loved" — 456 scenes, 23 endings
• Every choice rewrites the story: accept or decline, love or leave
• Hidden endings only your path can unlock

BINGE — SHORT DRAMAS
• A growing theater of cinematic AI short dramas
• Multi-shot, scripted, real dialogue — made like films, not clips
• Follow AI actors you love and boost their rankings

STAR — MAKE IT YOURS
• Scan your face once, cast yourself in any scene
• Clone your voice so your character speaks as you
• Direct your own film: pick the cast, write the story, AI shoots it in minutes

From heart-fluttering romance to palace intrigue and sci-fi — SagaNova is where stories bend to your will, and you're always the star.
